title: FREE REQUEST AVIAN MAN: A STRATEGY RPG - Seeking sprite & tileset artists!

posts.author: BurdyWurdy
posts.body:
​
AVIAN MAN:
A STRATEGY RPG
is a video game being developed in RPG Maker MZ. Set in the
Star Coast
, where breakthrough advancements in cybernetic and biological research have helped usher in an era of global peace and stability, you play as
Avian Man
and
Way Star
: two artificially enhanced heroes who have sworn an oath to protect the planet from invading forces of evil.
During a prolonged period of peacetime, agents representing a malicious organization named
Umbron
infiltrated a secret society belonging to the planet’s highest ranking authorities. Here they planted the seeds for their plans to dominate the globe. When the world’s leaders least expected it, they used the power of their four
Artificial Inhumanoids
to plunge the Star Coast into chaos. With no one left to fight this overwhelming force, a collective of scientists joined together to synthetically modify the bodies of two young men. Will these new heroes rise up to face the evil forces looming overhead, or will Umbron succeed and take control of the world?
GAME DESIGN PILLARS
………………………………………………………
I. EXPLORABLE SETTING
The Star Coast will be presented as an explorable overworld where a number of locations may be visited at any time, including mini dungeons, boss arenas, a bustling city, a laboratory, and various combat zones.
II. REACTIVE WORLD
The world around the players changes according to the ways it’s explored; conquering bosses and completing side quests alters the flow of various encounters, and makes different parts of the overworld map easier to traverse.
III. THRILLING BOSS FIGHTS
Four main boss encounters are spread throughout the game world, and will provide players with unique combat challenges that progress the main narrative, and reward players with currencies that can be spent in
New Peak City
.
These pillars will be consistently referenced throughout the development of quests, combat scenarios, and gameplay mechanics to ensure they align with a vision of a setting that is both satisfying to explore and challenging to overcome.
MOCKUPS

IN-ENGINE OVERWORLD TRAVEL DEMO
MAP USED NOT REPRESENTATIVE OF INTENDED PRODUCT - ONLY FOR TESTING PURPOSES
HELP I AM LOOKING FOR:
-Sprite artists
​
I am mostly seeking help with art at the moment. Most of the mechanics I'd like to include have been satisfied by existing plug-ins, and I would like to begin completing and commissioning sprite art and fine tune certain features. If you'd like, please feel free to DM me and I can provide further details concerning commissions. Currently, I am seeking art work for Avian Man, Way Star, Umbron's minions, and an Inhumanoid so I can organize a playable combat demo.
If you got this far, thank you for reading!
